title: DentDeID: open, tested de-identification for dental images
description: DentDeID removes patient-identifying information from dental images before they are shared for teaching, publication, referral or research: DICOM attributes following the DICOM PS3.15 (2026d) Basic Application Level Confidentiality Profile and its options (rule tables generated from the standard's own XML), burned-in text (a dental-aware morphological detector designed not to redact crowns, restorations, implants and brackets, with an identical JavaScript port), EXIF/GPS/XMP metadata and identifying file names of exported images and screenshots, faces in extra-oral photographs, and the facial re-identification risk of CBCT volumes. Every output is re-opened and re-checked, failures are quarantined, and audit reports contain no patient identifiers. Includes a Python library and CLI, a zero-install browser application, and the DentDeID-Synth benchmark generator. Validated on synthetic data only. De-identified dental images are not anonymous: the dentition itself is identifying.
references: DICOM Standards Committee (2026). DICOM PS3.15 2026d – Security and System Management Profiles, Annex E. NEMA.
